## ANIMATIONS & INTERACTIONS

### Framer Motion Usage
**Only Location:** Typewriter component in Hero section
- **Library:** framer-motion v12.38.0
- **Component:** `<motion.span>` with AnimatePresence
- **Animations:**
  - Initial: opacity: 0, y: 10
  - Animate: opacity: 1, y: 0
  - Exit: opacity: 0, y: -10
  - Duration: 0.28s, easeInOut
  - Cycles: Every 2400ms

### CSS Transitions
- All buttons: box-shadow, background-color, border-color transitions (0.3-0.4s)
- Navbar sticky scroll detection: onChange toggle
- FAQ chevron icon: transform rotate (0.2s)
- Carousel dot navigation: background-color (0.2s)
- Tooltip system: opacity (0.25s)
- Card hover states: background-color, box-shadow (0.3s)

### Interactive States (React)
- **Typewriter:** useState for phrase cycling (setInterval every 2400ms)
- **Navbar:** useState for mobile menu, beta popup, sticky scroll
- **Carousel (Embla):** useCallback for prev/next/scrollTo, useEffect for selection tracking
- **FAQ:** useState per item for open/close
- **Pricing:** useState for billing period toggle
- **Newsletter form:** useState for email, status, submitting
- **Footer form:** Similar to newsletter
